spanish: El sacerdote, el pecante a ella, la comerá; en lugar santo será comida, en el atrio de tienda de reunión.
grammarChanges: Inserted commas around 'el pecante a ella' so the participle governs its own object, instead of 'a ella la' reading as one doubled object of 'comerá'.
Added the definite article: 'en atrio' → 'en el atrio', since בַּ marks the court as definite.
readerNote: Added commas to set off 'el pecante a ella' as its own phrase, since Spanish cannot attach a direct object straight onto a bare participle the way the Hebrew piel participle takes אֹתָהּ.
